rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for being independent or no longer controlled by others.

example.english: I only truly felt independence after moving out and living on my own.
example.traditional: 搬出嚟自己住，我先真正感受到獨立。
example.jyutping: bun1 ceot1 lei4 zi6 gei2 zyu6 ngo5 sin1 zan1 zing3 gam2 sau6 dou3 duk6 laap6
